title: mentha suaveolens var. craspedota
intro: Mentha suaveolens var. craspedota, commonly known as Round Leaf Mint, is a variety of the mint plant that is native to Australia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving digestive issues, due to its health benefits. The plant exhibits therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of Round Leaf Mint include menthone, limonene, and beta-caryophyllene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
